rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; i1040sb p. 2, Line 6. The project reads sb.ordinary_dividends only when div.any is Yes (zero otherwise); the reply reads the input directly; on a completed return the input is unasked exactly when div.any is No. K-1 dividends are refused with the K-1 (scope.k1). Re-reviewed only because the foreign-trust gate's wording changed. Project stands.

Ruling: interface gap; the reply guessed this helper to be line 4 (after the Schedule B adjustments). The project's line is the sum of the payers' interest before adjustment (f1040sb Part I, line 1 and line 2, i1040sb p. 1 Line 1), which is what its label says; where no adjustment applies (refused otherwise by sb.h_bond_adjust and sb.nominee) the two equal. Re-reviewed only because the interest.amount wording changed. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; the candidate takes line 6 when div.any is yes and zero when it is no; the project takes box 1a (sb.ordinary_dividends) when div.any is yes and zero otherwise, and line 6 is a copy of this gate line with the Schedule B refusals, so the two agree on every return where line 6 is not refused (a refused line 6 refuses the return either way). Ruled by reading: the scoped reply names interfaces the candidate bank does not resolve, as in the earlier line-scoped passes of this lane.
